audience: Biologists, pathologists and clinically oriented collaborators; no computational-science background assumed.
central_question: Do neoplastic cells in Vehicle and PLX-treated tumours have different nuclear morphologies?
central_answer: In this four-mouse pilot, neoplastic-cell morphology differs across tissue environments, but the data do not establish one consistent PLX-associated morphology change across matched environments.
study_design_note: Four mice contribute one whole-slide image each (two Vehicle and two PLX4720). Results are exploratory; tiles and nuclei are subsamples, not independent treatment replicates.

conceptual_model.label: Why the main question must be separated
conceptual_model.equation: Observed whole-tumour morphology difference = tissue-environment mixture difference + within-matched-environment cell difference + mouse/slide/stain/segmentation variation

terms.explanation: A tumour can look different because it contains different proportions of pale, mixed, cohesive or elongated-looking H&E environments.

terms.plain_label: Cells differ within the same environment
terms.explanation: A treatment-associated cell-shape change is most credible if it appears when like tissue environments are compared with like.
With one slide per mouse, animal biology cannot be separated fully from section, stain, scan and segmentation variation.

eccentricity.direction: Higher values indicate a more elongated outline.

axis_ratio.direction: Higher values indicate a more elongated outline.
axis_ratio.caveat: A deterministic re-expression of eccentricity, not independent confirmation.

area.direction: Higher values indicate a larger segmented nuclear profile.

equivalent_diameter.direction: Higher values indicate a larger segmented nuclear profile.
equivalent_diameter.caveat: Derived directly from area, not independent confirmation.

perimeter.direction: Higher values indicate a longer segmented nuclear boundary.

compactness.direction: Higher values indicate a more compact, circle-like outline.

solidity.direction: Lower values indicate a more indented or irregular outline.

evidence_journey.title: First, do the tumours look different when tissue context is ignored?
evidence_journey.motivation: A whole-tumour comparison is the intuitive starting point, but it mixes every tissue environment in a slide.
evidence_journey.question: Across the four mice, are overall neoplastic nuclear measurements shifted between Vehicle and PLX4720?
evidence_journey.method: For each mouse, take the median across eligible high-confidence, non-edge neoplastic nuclei within each C2, C3 and C4 tile, then average the morphology-evaluable tiles equally. Compare the four mouse-level values; nuclei and tiles are not treated as treatment replicates.
evidence_journey.result_prompt: Show one dot per mouse in small metric panels, with Vehicle and PLX4720 separated. Display the PLX-minus-Vehicle difference and exact four-mouse permutation result as context, not as a discovery threshold.
evidence_journey.interpretation: Any restricted cellular-tissue difference is a candidate signal only: it may reflect altered C2–C4 mixture, a within-context cell change, or mouse/slide variation.

evidence_journey.title: What tissue environments are present in these sections?
evidence_journey.motivation: Neoplastic nuclear shape depends on the surrounding architecture, so biologically meaningful comparison requires a map of recurring H&E environments.
evidence_journey.question: What does each image-derived cluster appear to represent, where does it occur, and how confidently can it be named?
evidence_journey.method: Group UNI-v2 tile embeddings without using treatment labels or nuclear outcomes, then inspect representative tiles, slide locations, cell composition and morphology. Keep pathology names provisional until expert review.
evidence_journey.result_prompt: Show phenotype cards with full-resolution examples, slide locations, tile and nucleus coverage, morphology fingerprints and a three-level identity statement: technical description, candidate biological interpretation, pathologist confirmation status.
evidence_journey.interpretation: The clusters are recurring H&E image phenotypes, not proven anatomical compartments. Blank/background is not a biological morphology group, and all biological labels remain provisional.
evidence_journey.advanced_detail: Technical appendix: how the five image phenotypes were selected

evidence_journey.title: Do Vehicle and PLX4720 tumours contain different mixtures of tissue environments?
evidence_journey.motivation: A change in tumour architecture can shift whole-slide nuclear summaries even when cells do not change within matched environments.
evidence_journey.question: Does the proportion of tiles assigned to each tissue environment differ between treatment arms?
evidence_journey.method: Within each mouse's analysis-eligible cellular tissue, calculate the fractions of C2, C3 and C4 using all C2+C3+C4 image tiles as the denominator, including tiles with no eligible neoplastic nucleus. Compare the two Vehicle mice with the two PLX4720 mice; the three conditional fractions sum to 100%. Keep the complete C0/C1 definitions and exclusion rationale on the Tissue environments page.
evidence_journey.result_prompt: Use 100% stacked bars for the four individual mice and a separate dot plot of C2–C4 PLX-minus-Vehicle percentage-point differences. Label the denominator as the share of C2–C4 tiles; do not mix C0/C1 into treatment-facing plots.
evidence_journey.interpretation: Report candidate architecture shifts by cluster, but do not describe them as independent treatment effects or as proof of drug response.

evidence_journey.title: Do neoplastic nuclei naturally differ between tissue environments?
evidence_journey.motivation: Stratification is useful only if image environments correspond to interpretable differences in the nuclei they contain.
evidence_journey.question: Across all slides, which nuclear measurements distinguish the biological tile clusters, and do those differences recur across mice?
evidence_journey.method: Assign each mapped high-confidence neoplastic nucleus to its containing tile. For the treatment-evidence population, summarise C2, C3 and C4 morphology within tiles and mice before pooling. Compare these clusters descriptively and test tile-level classification with leave-one-mouse-out validation; retain C0/C1 definitions on the Tissue environments page.
evidence_journey.result_prompt: Use a cluster-by-metric effect heatmap for the overview, mouse-balanced distributions for a selected metric, four mouse dots for recurrence, and held-out-mouse confusion matrices for classification. Never connect unordered clusters with lines.
evidence_journey.interpretation: Morphology that distinguishes embedding clusters supports biological concordance, not independent validation: both tile embeddings and nuclear features come from the same H&E sections.

evidence_journey.title: Within the same tissue environment, does PLX4720 alter neoplastic nuclear morphology?
evidence_journey.motivation: Matching tissue context separates a possible cell-level change from a change in the amount of each environment.
evidence_journey.question: For each supported cluster and morphology metric, is the PLX-minus-Vehicle direction consistent across mice?
evidence_journey.method: Within each C2, C3 and C4 cellular-tissue cluster, calculate one morphology summary per mouse, compare two Vehicle with two PLX4720 mice, and inspect leave-one-mouse-out direction when all four mice pass the support gate. Mark C3 treatment inference as limited when M363 does not meet tile support. Do not pool nuclei as treatment replicates.
evidence_journey.result_prompt: Use a cluster-by-metric treatment-effect heatmap. Selecting a cell must reveal the four raw mouse dots, sample coverage and robustness status; unsupported cells display N/A rather than zero.
evidence_journey.interpretation: A credible shared treatment phenotype would require comparable directions across supported contexts and mice. Heterogeneous directions argue against a cluster-invariant effect in this pilot.

evidence_journey.title: Does the treatment contrast remain after equalising tissue-environment mixture?
evidence_journey.motivation: Standardisation asks what the overall comparison would look like if every mouse contributed the same supported cluster mixture.
evidence_journey.question: How does the overall morphology contrast change under equal-cluster and pooled-reference weighting?
evidence_journey.method: Compare each mouse's observed C2–C4 morphology-evaluable-tile summary with an equal-C2/C3/C4 reweighting, then repeat the standardisation in the fully supported C2/C4 subset. Compare the same four mouse-level values under each estimand.
evidence_journey.result_prompt: Use aligned observed-mixture and equal-mixture mouse-dot panels on the same scale, with the fully supported C2/C4 analysis shown separately. Any descriptive decomposition must include its covariance residual and must not be presented as causal. Do not imply that reweighting creates additional animals.
evidence_journey.interpretation: If standardised estimates remain mouse-sensitive or disagree across contexts, the data do not support a composition-independent treatment effect.

evidence_journey.title: What do these four mice allow us to conclude?
evidence_journey.motivation: The final claim must reflect biological evidence, experimental replication and technical uncertainty together.
evidence_journey.question: Which observations are supported, which are hypotheses, and what evidence is still needed?
evidence_journey.method: Triangulate whole-slide, architecture, cross-context, within-context, standardised and sensitivity results; preserve mouse as the experimental unit.
evidence_journey.result_prompt: Show a claim-evidence matrix with Supported observation, Candidate hypothesis, Not established and Next validation columns. Keep technical sensitivity tables collapsible.
evidence_journey.interpretation: Current evidence supports heterogeneous tissue contexts and context-associated nuclear morphology. It does not establish a causal, cluster-invariant PLX-induced nuclear phenotype.

chart_rules.required_for_treatment_inference: Show the four mouse-level observations wherever a treatment contrast is presented.
chart_rules.missing_data: Render unsupported estimates as N/A with the reason; never coerce missing or insufficient evidence to zero.
chart_rules.colour: Treatment colour and cluster colour encode different concepts and must not be reused interchangeably.
chart_rules.tooltips: Every interactive mark must state metric, unit, aggregation level, denominator and sample coverage.
chart_rules.technical_detail: K selection, clustering stability, sensitivity grids and implementation parameters belong in Methods & QC or collapsible advanced detail.
